result.summary: The page is mostly well laid out. The main defect is in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, where the first two cards are identical duplicates. There are also a few minor contrast and consistency concerns.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first two cards are exact duplicates: same 'Green Bowl Poké' name, image, 15–25 min badge and €0.90 delivery fee. This looks like a data or rendering bug and wastes prime space on the most prominent carousel.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the restaurant list by ID before rendering, and check the API or data source for repeated entries.

issues.description: The secondary gray text ('€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') is light and small on a white background, so contrast is low. The placeholder text in the search bar is also faint.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1) and slightly increase the font size.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the food images sits on a translucent dark circle over busy photos. The ramen card's circle is almost invisible, and the icon's contrast varies between cards.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent solid or semi-opaque background for the favorite button so it is clearly visible on all images.

issues.description: The time badges on the carousel cards overlap the bottom-left edge of the image and look cramped. The white pill also sits close to the plate image.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent inset padding for the badges and make sure they do not collide with the image content.

issues.description: Illustrated placeholder-style images (a generic bowl, a generic pizza) are used instead of real restaurant photos or logos. The cards also have no restaurant identity beyond the name, and the pizza card has a discount badge but no visible title yet.
issues.suggestion: Use real restaurant imagery and make sure the title and metadata are present for each card.
